source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 29 (PDF 186-201), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 29 (Spectroscopy-1) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is electromagnetic radiation? Name the quantities that define its waves.
(Electromagnetic radiation kya hai? Is ki waves kin miqdaaron se bayan hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Light aur doosri electromagnetic radiation oscillating electric aur magnetic fields ki waves ki shakal mein chalti hain. Yeh waves wavelength (λ) aur frequency (ν) se bayan hoti hain aur light ki speed c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s se chalti hain, c = λν.

book_ref.quote: which consist of oscillating electric and magnetic fields

blocks.prompt:
2 Calculate the frequency of radiation of wavelength 400 nm (c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).
(400 nm wavelength wali radiation ki frequency nikalein (c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).)

book_ref.quote: where λ is the wavelength (in meters), ν is the frequency (in Hertz or s⁻¹)

blocks.prompt:
3 Name the radiations that make up the electromagnetic spectrum.
(Electromagnetic spectrum kin radiations par mushtamil hai? Naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light, ultraviolet radiation, X-rays aur gamma rays.

book_ref.quote: including radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, visible light, ultraviolet radiation, X-rays, and gamma rays

blocks.prompt:
4 State the two points of Planck's quantum theory given in the chapter.
(Chapter mein di gayi Planck ki quantum theory ke do nukaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Atoms aur molecules sirf alag alag (discrete) miqdaar mein energy kharij ya jazb karte hain; radiation ki sab se chhoti miqdaar quantum hai. (ii) Radiation ki frequency aur us ki energy directly proportional hain.

book_ref.quote: Only discrete amounts of energy may be emitted or absorbed by various atoms and molecules

blocks.prompt:
5 Write the expressions for the energy of radiation in terms of frequency, wavelength and wavenumber.
(Radiation ki energy frequency, wavelength aur wavenumber ke hawale se likhein.)
blocks.explanation: E = hν (frequency); E = hc/λ (wavelength); E = hcν̄, jahan ν̄ = 1/λ wavenumber hai (cm⁻¹ mein). h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.

book_ref.quote: With the frequency the energy is E = hν

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: kitaab E = hcν chhapti hai. Frequency ke saath sahi formula E = hν hai; c wala formula sirf wavenumber ν̄ (cm⁻¹) ke saath E = hcν̄ banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 Calculate the energy of a photon of wavelength 450 nm (h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).
(450 nm wavelength wale photon ki energy nikalein (h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m/s).)

book_ref.quote: h = Planck's constant (6.626×10⁻³⁴ J.s)

blocks.prompt:
7 Define the index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD).
(Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD) ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Degree of unsaturation (U) ya IHD compound aur usi tadaad ke carbon wale acyclic alkane ke darmiyan hydrogen atoms ke joron (pairs) ki tadaad ka farq hai. Har do ghaib hydrogen atoms par aik degree of unsaturation.

book_ref.quote: The degree of unsaturation (U), or index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD), is defined as

blocks.prompt:
8 Why do 1-hexene and cyclohexane have the same IHD?
(1-Hexene aur cyclohexane ka IHD aik jaisa kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono C₆H₁₂ isomers hain aur saturated alkane C₆H₁₄ se do hydrogen kam hain. 1-Hexene mein aik double bond aur cyclohexane mein aik ring hai; har aik do hydrogen kam karta hai, is liye dono ka IHD = 1.

book_ref.quote: This is why the above two compounds have an IHD equal to 1.

blocks.prompt:
9 Calculate the IHD of C₆H₁₀ and state two structures it could have.
(C₆H₁₀ ka IHD nikalein aur do mumkin structures batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Saturated C₆ alkane = C₆H₁₄; 14 − 10 = 4 H kam = 2 jore, is liye IHD = 2. Is mein do double bonds, do rings, aik ring aur aik double bond, ya aik triple bond ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Each double bond or ring costs two hydrogen atoms compared to a saturated analog

blocks.prompt:
10 Find the IHD of ethyne, C₂H₂, and of propene, C₃H₆.
(Ethyne, C₂H₂, aur propene, C₃H₆, ka IHD nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: C₂H₂: C₂H₆ − C₂H₂ = 4 H = 2 jore, IHD = 2 (aik triple bond). C₃H₆: C₃H₈ − C₃H₆ = 2 H = 1 jora, IHD = 1 (aik double bond).

book_ref.quote: Each double bond or ring costs two hydrogen atoms compared to a saturated analog

blocks.prompt:
11 How many IHD units do a ring, a double bond and a triple bond each contribute?
(Ring, double bond aur triple bond har aik IHD ke kitne units deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ring aik IHD, double bond aik IHD aur triple bond do IHD ginta hai.

book_ref.quote: A double bond and ring each counts as one IHD. A triple bond counts as two IHD.

blocks.prompt:
12 Give the importance of IHD.
(IHD ki ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: IHD sirf molecular formula se mil jata hai aur bina complex techniques ke composition aur structure (rings aur multiple bonds) ke ishare deta hai. Yeh yeh andaaza lagane mein bhi madad deta hai ke compound ke liye kaun si technique behtar hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, IHD can give us very useful information about a chemical without using complex analytical techniques

blocks.prompt:
13 What structural possibilities are there for a compound with IHD = 1 and for one with IHD = 0?
(IHD = 1 aur IHD = 0 wale compounds mein kaun si structures mumkin hain?)
blocks.explanation: IHD = 1: ya aik ring ya aik double bond, dono nahi. IHD = 0: koi ring ya double bond nahi (hydrocarbon ke liye zanjeer wala alkane).

book_ref.quote: If the IHD is 1, the chemical must have either one ring or one double bond, but it cannot have both

blocks.prompt:
14 Hopanes, C₃₀H₅₂, are saturated hydrocarbons. Calculate their IHD and say where it comes from.
(Hopanes, C₃₀H₅₂, saturated hydrocarbons hain. In ka IHD nikalein aur batayein yeh kahan se aata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Saturated C₃₀ alkane = C₃₀H₆₂; 62 − 52 = 10 H = 5 jore, IHD = 5. Saturated (koi double bond nahi) hone ki wajah se paanchon units paanch rings se hain.

book_ref.quote: Hopanes are saturated hydrocarbons with five rings and the formula C₃₀H₅₂ (IHD = 5)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Book correction: kitaab hopane ka formula C₃₀H₆₂ chhapti hai jo zanjeer wale alkane (IHD 0) ka hai. Sahi formula C₃₀H₅₂ hai.

blocks.prompt:
15 What are atomic spectra? What evidence do they provide?
(Atomic spectra kya hain? Yeh kis baat ka saboot dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Atomic spectra tab dekhe jate hain jab atoms khaas wavelengths ki light kharij ya jazb karein (emission aur absorption spectra). Yeh saboot dete hain ke electrons sirf discrete energy levels ke darmiyan transition karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Atomic spectra are observed when atoms emit or absorb light of a certain wavelength

blocks.prompt:
16 How is an emission spectrum formed?
(Emission spectrum kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam pressure wali gas ko garam karne se electrons ooper levels par chale jate hain. Wapsi par har transition khaas wavelength ka photon kharij karta hai jo kaale background par rangeen lines ki shakal mein dikhta hai.

book_ref.quote: These excited electrons radiate energy to return from the excited state to ground states and form emission spectra

blocks.prompt:
17 Distinguish between an emission spectrum and an absorption spectrum.
(Emission spectrum aur absorption spectrum mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Emission spectrum excite atoms ki kharij ki hui light hai; absorption spectrum woh light hai jo safaid light ke thandi gas se guzarne ke baad ghaib hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Absorption spectra can be produced by passing white light through a cool, low-pressure gas

rows: Kam pressure wali gas ko garam kar ke banta hai.
Safaid light ko thandi, kam pressure wali gas se guzaar kar banta hai.
Excite electrons neeche levels par aa kar photons kharij karte hain.
Ground state electrons bilkul barabar energy ke photons jazb kar ke ooper jate hain.
Kaale background par rangeen lines.
Rangeen background par kaali lines.
Element ki khaas wavelengths par lines.
Unhi wavelengths par kaali lines; emission spectrum ka photographic negative.

blocks.prompt:
18 Why is an absorption spectrum called a photographic negative of the emission spectrum?
(Absorption spectrum ko emission spectrum ka photographic negative kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi element ke absorption spectrum ki kaali lines unhi wavelengths par hoti hain jahan emission spectrum ki rangeen lines; sirf shakal ulat jati hai (kaale par rangeen ki jagah rangeen par kaali).

book_ref.quote: An absorption spectrum is like a photographic negative of an emission spectrum

blocks.prompt:
19 Define spectroscopy. What information can a spectrum give?
(Spectroscopy ki definition likhein. Spectrum kya maloomat de sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spectroscopy electromagnetic radiation aur matter ke amal se bane spectra ki paidaish, paimaish aur tashreeh ka ilm hai. Spectrum atomic aur molecular energy levels, molecular geometry, molecules ke amal aur chemical bonds ki nature ki maloomat deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Spectroscopy deals with the production, measurement, and interpretation of spectra

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between qualitative and quantitative analysis by spectroscopy.
(Spectroscopy ke zariye qualitative aur quantitative analysis mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Quantitative analysis miqdaar napta hai; qualitative analysis pehchan karta hai.

book_ref.quote: for measuring the amount of a specific substance in a sample (quantitative analysis)

rows: Na-maloom sample ki pehchan karta hai.
Sample mein kisi khaas substance ki miqdaar napta hai.
Sawal: 'kya maujood hai?'
Sawal: 'kitna maujood hai?'

blocks.prompt:
21 Why are emission line spectra compared to fingerprints?
(Emission line spectra ko fingerprints se kyun tashbeeh di jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har element lines ka munfarid pattern deta hai aur koi do elements aik jaisa set nahi dete. Is liye fingerprint ki tarah spectrum element ki pehchan karata hai.

book_ref.quote: Emission line spectra are unique to each element, like a fingerprint

blocks.prompt:
22 Give the characteristic spectral lines or colours of hydrogen, sodium and mercury.
(Hydrogen, sodium aur mercury ki khaas spectral lines ya rang batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen: 656 nm par mazboot surkh line. Sodium: peela shola, 589 nm par mazboot lines. Mercury: zyada tar lines 450 nm se neeche, neeli light.

book_ref.quote: When sodium is burned, a characteristic yellow flame is observed

blocks.prompt:
23 How do astronomers use atomic spectra?
(Astronomers atomic spectra ko kaise istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sitaron ki kharij light ka tajziya kar ke astronomers lines ko elements se milate hain aur sitaron ki chemical composition maloom karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Atomic spectra can also help astronomers to determine the chemical composition of stars

blocks.prompt:
24 What is measured in UV-Vis spectroscopy and how is absorbance obtained from it?
(UV-Vis spectroscopy mein kya napa jata hai aur us se absorbance kaise milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: UV-Vis light sample se guzari jati hai aur transmittance (T) napi jati hai. Absorbance A = −log (T). Spectrum mukhtalif wavelengths par absorbance dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: In UV-Vis spectroscopy, the UV-Vis light is passed through a sample and the transmittance of light is measured

blocks.prompt:
25 A solution transmits 25% of the incident light. Calculate its absorbance.
(Aik solution aane wali light ka 25% guzarta hai. Us ki absorbance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The absorbance (A) can be determined from the transmittance (T) using the formula A = −log (T)

blocks.prompt:
26 Name the types of electrons in a compound that are involved in UV-Vis absorption. Arrange their orbitals by energy.
(UV-Vis absorption mein shamil electrons ki qismein batayein. Un ke orbitals ko energy ki tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: σ electrons (σ-bonds), π electrons (sirf unsaturated compounds) aur n electrons (non-bonded). Orbital energy: σ bonding < π bonding < non-bonding (n).

book_ref.quote: Types of electrons in a compound can be:

blocks.prompt:
27 List the important electronic transitions studied in UV-Vis spectroscopy.
(UV-Vis spectroscopy mein study hone wali ahem electronic transitions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: π → π* (pi bonding se pi anti-bonding), n → π* (non-bonding se pi anti-bonding) aur n → σ* (non-bonding se sigma anti-bonding). Har aik mein electron bhare orbital se khaali anti-bonding orbital mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The important electronic transitions are:

blocks.prompt:
28 What is λmax? Why is buta-1,3-diene colourless although it absorbs at 217 nm?
(λmax kya hai? Buta-1,3-diene 217 nm par jazb karne ke bawajood be-rang kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: λmax sab se zyada absorption wali wavelength hai. Buta-1,3-diene ka 217 nm hai jo UV region mein hai, is liye koi visible light jazb nahi hoti aur compound be-rang hai.

book_ref.quote: Absorption peaks at a value of 217 nm corresponds to the wavelength absorbed maximum and is called λₘₐₓ

blocks.prompt:
29 Why does buta-1,3-diene show only π → π* transitions in its UV-Vis spectrum?
(Buta-1,3-diene ke UV-Vis spectrum mein sirf π → π* transitions kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: CH₂=CH–CH=CH₂ mein koi non-bonding electrons nahi, is liye napi range mein sirf π bonding se π anti-bonding orbitals ke jumps hote hain.

book_ref.quote: There are no non-bonding electrons so the only electron jumps taking place

blocks.prompt:
30 Why does λmax increase with the extent of conjugation?
(Conjugation barhne se λmax kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada conjugated compound mein zyada energy levels aur chhote gaps hote hain, is liye electron excite karne ko kam energy chahiye. Kam energy = kam frequency aur lambi wavelength, is liye λmax barhta hai (har izaafi double bond par taqreeban 30-40 nm).

book_ref.quote: Because these gaps are smaller, it takes less energy to push an electron from a low level to a higher one

blocks.prompt:
31 Arrange butadiene, hexatriene and octatetraene in increasing order of λmax and give the reason.
(Butadiene, hexatriene aur octatetraene ko λmax ki barhti tarteeb mein likhein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Butadiene < hexatriene < octatetraene (butadiene 217 nm, octatetraene 290 nm). Conjugated double bonds (2, 3, 4) barhte hain, energy gap kam hota hai aur λmax barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The printed value for octatetraene, '290', has no unit; it is 290 nm.

blocks.prompt:
32 Why do green and red ripe tomatoes have different colours?
(Sabz aur surkh pakke tamatar ke rang mukhtalif kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sabz tamatar mein chlorophyll zyada hai jab ke surkh pakke tamatar mein lycopene hai. In dono ke λmax mukhtalif hain aur har aik ka visible range mein khaas rang hai.

book_ref.quote: Green tomato has chlorophyll in higher quantities, while red tomato contains lycopene

blocks.prompt:
33 What happens when an organic molecule absorbs infrared radiation?
(Jab organic molecule infrared radiation jazb kare to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Covalent bonds springs ki tarah IR region ki frequencies par vibrate karte hain. Agar IR energy bond ki qudrati vibration frequency ke barabar ho to molecule kuch energy jazb karta hai aur vibration ka amplitude barh jata hai.

book_ref.quote: All covalent bonds act rather like springs, the bonds can vibrate in a number of different ways

blocks.prompt:
34 Define infrared spectroscopy.
(Infrared spectroscopy ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: IR spectroscopy compounds ki pehchan ki technique hai jo khaas frequencies ki IR jazb karne par atoms ki vibrations ki tabdeeli par mabni hai. Spectrophotometer sample par IR dalta hai aur jazb hone wali radiation pakarta hai.

book_ref.quote: Infrared (IR) spectroscopy is a technique used to identify compounds which is based on changes in vibrations

blocks.prompt:
35 Why are O₂ and H₂ IR inactive?
(O₂ aur H₂ IR inactive kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: IR energy sirf tab jazb hoti hai jab molecule ka permanent dipole vibration ke saath badle. O₂ aur H₂ symmetrical aur non-polar hain, un ka aisa dipole nahi, is liye IR jazb nahi karte.

book_ref.quote: Symmetrical and nonpolar molecules such as O₂ or H₂, are, therefore, IR inactive

blocks.prompt:
36 Give reason: O–H, N–H and multiple bonds absorb at higher wavenumbers.
(Wajah batayein: O–H, N–H aur multiple bonds zyada wavenumbers par jazb karte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Polar bonds, chhoti bond length wale bonds aur multiple bonds (maslan HC≡CH) mazboot hain aur vibrate karne ke liye zyada energy chahte hain, is liye zyada wavenumbers par jazb karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The reason for these observations is that these bonds are stronger and require higher energy

blocks.prompt:
37 Differentiate between the fingerprint region and the functional group region of an IR spectrum.
(IR spectrum ke fingerprint region aur functional group region mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono regions 1500 cm⁻¹ par taqseem hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The fingerprint region below 1500 cm⁻¹ and the functional group region above 1500 cm⁻¹

rows: 1500 cm⁻¹ se neeche.
1500 cm⁻¹ se ooper.
Chapter mein is par baat nahi ki gayi.
Chapter mein istemal; organic compound ki nature samajhne ke liye kaafi.

blocks.prompt:
38 How does a roadside breathalyser measure alcohol?
(Roadside breathalyser alcohol kaise napta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chamber mein kharij saans se IR radiation guzari jati hai. Ethanol ke khaas bonds pakre jate hain; jitni zyada IR absorbance, utna zyada ethanol.

book_ref.quote: A ray of infrared radiation is passed through the breath that is exhaled into the breathalyser chamber

blocks.prompt:
39 Give the IR absorption ranges of the O–H bond in a carboxylic acid and in an alcohol (hydroxy group).
(Carboxylic acid aur alcohol (hydroxy group) mein O–H bond ki IR absorption ranges likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Carboxyl group ka O–H: 2500–3300 cm⁻¹ (chaurra). Hydroxy group ka O–H: 3200–3600 cm⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Table 29.2 IR Absorption ranges of functional groups (cm⁻¹)

blocks.prompt:
40 A compound shows a sharp absorption at 2230 cm⁻¹. Which functional group does it contain?
(Aik compound 2230 cm⁻¹ par tez absorption dikhata hai. Is mein kaun sa functional group hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2230 cm⁻¹ C≡N bond ki 2200–2250 cm⁻¹ range (Table 29.2) mein hai, is liye compound nitrile hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 29.2 IR Absorption ranges of functional groups (cm⁻¹)

blocks.prompt:
41 How can IR spectroscopy tell propanone from propan-2-ol?
(IR spectroscopy propanone ko propan-2-ol se kaise alag karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Propanone 1710 cm⁻¹ ke qareeb mazboot, tez C=O absorption (ketone) dikhata hai. Propan-2-ol –OH group ki wajah se 3200–3600 cm⁻¹ par mazboot absorption dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: IR spectrum A is propanone.

blocks.prompt:
42 How do the IR spectra of an amine and an amide differ?
(Amine aur amide ke IR spectra mein kya farq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono N–H peaks dikhate hain, magar C=O sirf amide dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: The N−H bond in an amine gives rise to two weak absorptions at 3300 and 3400 cm⁻¹

rows: N–H: 3300 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par do kamzor absorptions.
N–H: 3200 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par do peaks.
Koi C=O absorption nahi.
1660 cm⁻¹ par C=O absorption.

blocks.prompt:
43 Describe the main IR features of a carboxylic acid.
(Carboxylic acid ke IR spectrum ki ahem khasoosiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: 1700 cm⁻¹ par mazboot C=O absorption aur 2500 se 3300 cm⁻¹ ke darmiyan chaurra, gehra O–H absorption, jis ka daayan hissa aksar C–H peaks se bigar jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The C=O group in the carboxylic acids shows a strong absorption at 1700 cm⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
44 Compare the N–H signal of amines with the O–H signal of alcohols.
(Amines ke N–H signal ka alcohols ke O–H signal se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono chaurre aur zyada wavenumber par hain, magar alcohols ka O–H signal zyada chaurra hai.

book_ref.quote: N-H signal in amines is broad but it is not broader than O-H signal in alcohols

rows: 3300 aur 3400 cm⁻¹ par do kamzor absorptions.
3600–3200 cm⁻¹ par mazboot absorption.
Chaurra, magar O–H se zyada nahi.
N–H signal se zyada chaurra.

blocks.prompt:
45 Give one use of IR spectroscopy in monitoring pollution.
(Aaloodgi (pollution) ki nigrani mein IR spectroscopy ka aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Air sensors IR spectroscopy se gaariyon ke dhuen mein carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide aur na-jale hydrocarbons jaise pollutants ko motorways aur masroof shehri ilaqon mein pakarte aur napte hain.

book_ref.quote: The air sensors detect and measure the amount of pollutants such as carbon monoxide

blocks.prompt:
46 What is mass spectrometry? How are the results recorded?
(Mass spectrometry kya hai? Nataij kaise record hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mass spectrometry na-maloom compounds ki pehchan ki analytical technique hai. Sample par zyada energy wale electrons ki bombardment se positive ions bante hain jo detect ho kar m/e (mass to charge ratio) banam ion ke percentage ki shakal mein record hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Mass spectrometry is an analytical technique used to identify unknown compounds

blocks.prompt:
47 Define relative abundance of an isotope. How is it shown in a mass spectrum?
(Isotope ki relative abundance ki definition likhein. Mass spectrum mein yeh kaise dikhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Relative abundance qudrati isotopes ke mixture mein kisi khaas isotope ka hissa hai. Mass spectrum mein peaks ki unchai har isotope ka hissa dikhati hai (maslan B-10 19.9%, B-11 80.1%).

book_ref.quote: The relative abundance is the proportion of a particular isotope in a mixture of isotopes found in nature

blocks.prompt:
48 An element has isotopes of mass 69 (60.1%) and 71 (39.9%). Calculate its relative atomic mass to 2 decimal places.
(Aik element ke isotopes mass 69 (60.1%) aur 71 (39.9%) hain. Us ka relative atomic mass 2 decimal tak nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The relative atomic mass of an element can be calculated by using the relative abundance and isotopic masses

blocks.prompt:
49 An element has two isotopes of mass 10 and 11 and Aᵣ = 10.81. Find the percentage of the mass-11 isotope.
(Aik element ke do isotopes mass 10 aur 11 hain aur Aᵣ = 10.81. Mass-11 isotope ka percentage nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The relative abundance of an isotope is either given or can be read the mass spectrum

blocks.prompt:
50 What is a molecular ion? Write the equation for its formation.
(Molecular ion kya hai? Is ke banne ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Molecular ion poora molecule hai jis ne electrons ki beam ki bombardment se aik electron kho diya; yeh positive hai aur is mein aik unpaired electron hai. Molecule + electron bombardment → Molecule⁺• + e⁻.

book_ref.quote: The molecular ion is the entire molecule that has lost one electron when bombarded with a beam of electrons

blocks.prompt:
51 A compound may be ethanal, CH₃CHO, or propanone, CH₃COCH₃. Its molecular ion peak is at m/e = 44. Identify it (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16).
(Aik compound ethanal, CH₃CHO, ya propanone, CH₃COCH₃, ho sakta hai. Is ki molecular ion peak m/e = 44 par hai. Pehchan karein (C = 12, H = 1, O = 16).)
blocks.explanation: CH₃CHO: 2(12) + 4(1) + 16 = 44; CH₃COCH₃: 3(12) + 6(1) + 16 = 58. M⁺ peak 44 par hai, is liye compound ethanal hai.

book_ref.quote: The peak mostly with the highest m/e value is the molecular ion (M⁺) peak

blocks.prompt:
52 Why is fragmentation needed when the molecular ion peak already gives the molecular mass?
(Jab molecular ion peak molecular mass de deti hai to fragmentation ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif compounds ki molecular mass aik jaisi ho sakti hai. Fragments ka pattern (khaas chhote ions ya chhote molecules ka nikalna, maslan 18 par H₂O aur 44 par CO₂) structure maloom karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: To further determine the structure of the unknown compound, fragmentation is used

blocks.prompt:
53 Predict the m/e values of the molecular ion and the C–C fragments of straight-chain butane, CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ (C = 12, H = 1).
(Seedhi zanjeer wale butane, CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₃ (C = 12, H = 1), ke molecular ion aur C–C fragments ki m/e qeematein batayein.)
blocks.explanation: M⁺ = 4(12) + 10(1) = 58. C–C fragments: C₃H₇⁺ 43, C₂H₅⁺ 29, CH₃⁺ 15.

book_ref.quote: Simple alkanes are fragmented in mass spectroscopy by breaking the C-C bonds

blocks.prompt:
54 What causes the [M+1] peak? Why is it larger for hexane than for ethane?
([M+1] peak kis wajah se banti hai? Yeh ethane ke muqable mein hexane ke liye bari kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh carbon-13 ki wajah se hai jo carbon atoms ka taqreeban 1.1% hai (¹³C : ¹²C ≈ 1 : 99). Jitne zyada carbon, ¹³C ka utna zyada imkaan, is liye hexane (6 C) ki [M+1] peak ethane (2 C) se bari hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, the greater the number of carbon atoms present in a molecule the greater the height of the [M+1] peak

blocks.prompt:
55 The M⁺ peak of a compound has a relative abundance of 50 and its [M+1] peak 2.2. How many carbon atoms does it contain?
(Aik compound ki M⁺ peak ki relative abundance 50 aur [M+1] peak ki 2.2 hai. Is mein kitne carbon atoms hain?)
